CASES = [
    (['0'], 'norm_num [Complex.ext_iff, pow_two]', True),
    (['Complex.I'], 'norm_num [Complex.ext_iff, pow_two]', False),
    (['(-Complex.I)'], 'norm_num [Complex.ext_iff, pow_two]', False),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, proof, edge in CASES]
